posts.text: Saudi Arabia has sold ~60 million barrels of Ras Tanura crude for ship-to-ship transfer at Sohar, Oman, bypassing the shut Yanbu route — the relay is now near capacity, per gCaptain and MarineLink.

New this run: Saudi Arabia is routing ~60m barrels via a Sohar, Oman ship-to-ship relay to bypass the shut Yanbu route, and Trump says US-Iran talks may resume this week. Brent remains near $104/bbl, up ~44% since the pre-crisis week.
